from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess

    return subprocess.check_output(args, text=True)

for name, count in [('01 Room Signs.pdf', 7), ('02 Visitor Handouts.pdf', 1), ('03 Volunteer Setup.pdf', 1)]:

    assert not re.search(r'"'^(Author|Creator|Producer|CreationDate|ModDate):'"', info, re.M)
